mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, increasing dolutegravir exposure; dolutegravir is also a substrate for UGT1A1 and some CYP3A4 metabolism.
action: Monitor dolutegravir levels and efficacy; consider alternative antibiotic such as azithromycin if possible; dolutegravir dose adjustment is not typically required but clinical monitoring is recommended.
